# step1_basic.py
from pydantic_ai import Agent
from common import make_model, show_context, watch

agent = Agent(make_model(), instructions="You are a concise study-planning assistant.", capabilities=[watch])
result = agent.run_sync("In one sentence: what is an agent?")
print(result.output)
show_context()
description: Minimal agent with instructions only: run_sync sends the prompt, show_context displays what the model received.
